title: onobrychis arenaria subsp. lasiostachya
intro: Onobrychis arenaria subsp. lasiostachya, commonly known as mountain sainfoin, is a plant species in the legume family (Fabaceae) that is native to Europe and Asia. The health benefits of mountain sainfoin include its potential to improve cardiovascular health and reduce inflammation due to its high content of isoflavones and other bioactive compounds. The therapeutic actions of mountain sainfoin include its ability to act as an antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and vasodilator, making it a potential remedy for conditions such as hypertension and atherosclerosis. The bioactive constituents of mountain sainfoin include isoflavones, saponins, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its therapeutic properties.
